panels.title: Memory used
panels.description: Memory Redis uses, as a share of its maxmemory limit. Empty when Redis has no limit. Past the limit, Redis evicts keys that expire.

panels.title: Club details expire in
panels.description: Time to live of the scheduled clubs' details in Redis. Each club's details stay a day past its next refresh, so the soonest should stay above a day while the refresher keeps up.

panels.title: Keys expired and evicted per hour
panels.description: Expired keys reached their TTL. Evicted keys were removed because Redis hit its memory limit; any evictions mean it needs more memory.
